videos.old_description:
What happens inside your liver when you drink alcohol? This 3D medical animation follows alcohol from your digestive system into the bloodstream, then inside liver cells as it is broken down.

You’ll see:
• how most alcohol is processed in the liver
• why a short-lived toxic chemical forms
• how repeated heavy drinking can contribute to fat buildup and inflammation
• how long-term injury can create scar tissue
• what may improve after alcohol stops—and what may not

LIVO and ALCO make the opening easy to follow, while the bloodstream, liver cells, enzymes, fat buildup, inflammation and scar tissue are shown as simplified educational visualizations.

⚠️ Educational content only. This video is not medical advice, diagnosis or treatment. If you drink heavily or may be alcohol-dependent, do not stop suddenly without medical guidance because alcohol withdrawal can be dangerous. Speak with a qualified healthcare professional.

🚶‍♂️ What happens to your blood sugar when you walk after eating?

Discover how a short walk after meals helps your muscles absorb glucose, activates GLUT4 transporters, and reduces post-meal blood sugar spikes.

This 3D medical animation explains the science behind walking after meals and how movement supports healthy blood sugar control.
